title: Who's Who Definitive Directory DC Universe #5 1985 Cyborg Clayface Creeper
condition_description: Bright covers, light handling wear; light toning at the edges. See photos.
description:
Who's Who: The Definitive Directory of the DC Universe #5 (July 1985), DC Comics - Volume V, Chronos through Cyclotron. Entries include Circe, Clayface I/II/III, Clock King, Cluemaster, Colossal Boy, Composite Superman, Cosmic Boy, Creeper, Crime Syndicate, Crimson Avenger, Croc, Cyborg and more. Wraparound cover, back by George Perez and Dick Giordano. $1.00 cover price.

Condition: bright with light handling wear and light toning at the edges (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.

Series Title: Who's Who: The Definitive Directory of the DC Universe
